- Live streams play, with a LIVE badge: grey when you've gone back, tap it to catch up
- Search suggests as you type: the channel you mean (with its picture), a clear video match, and your past searches. Remove any you don't want, or tap the arrow to edit one
- Shorts links (from the YouTube app, a message, anywhere) open in a full-screen Shorts player: it loops, tap to pause, like, dislike, comments and Subscribe. Shorts still stay out of your feeds and channel pages
- Channel banners are back edge to edge with their fade, and bigger: the whole TV-size picture
- Posts open with the comments right under them and the box to write yours, all in the creator's colors
- New setting: turn Posts off to never see posts or polls, in feeds, search or on channels
